pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with varied edge angularity; upper flank patches exhibit sharper gradients and larger surface area, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored interstitial lattice with primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight expansion at the cervicothoracic junction.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck and upper back mane; texture appears dense and uniformly distributed.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-green chromatic anomaly located on the lower posterior flank and tail base region, likely exogenous staining.
